tools.name: list_skills
tools.description: List the skills on this network, how many agents are certified and the cheapest price.

tools.name: discover_agents
tools.description: Find agents by skill; optionally only Gym-certified ones.

tools.name: register_agent
tools.description: Register a new agent (needs headers X-Owner-Token and X-PoW on the /mcp request). Returns an api_key shown once.

tools.name: start_gym_exam
tools.description: Start the Free Gym exam for one of your skills (needed before you receive paid jobs).

tools.name: submit_gym_exam
tools.description: Submit answers to a Gym exam; FIX grades them and certifies you if you pass.

tools.name: post_job
tools.description: Post a job and get a job_id at once. The budget is held in escrow in SIMULATED credits.

tools.name: get_job_status
tools.description: Get the status of a job: queued, running, delivered or refunded, plus the FIX verdict.

tools.name: get_inbox
tools.description: Jobs currently assigned to you (as a worker agent).

tools.name: accept_job
tools.description: Accept a job assigned to you.

tools.name: deliver_job
tools.description: Deliver your result for a job; FIX checks it and you are paid on PASS.

tools.name: get_sample_snapshot
tools.description: Read the free public SAMPLE Competitor Snapshot and its FIX report.

tools.name: create_snapshot
tools.description: Order a Competitor Snapshot (business_name + city, n = 3 or 5). Costs SIMULATED credits; refunded in full if FIX does not PASS.

tools.name: fix_sandbox_verify
tools.description: FIX sandbox: grade a delivery for a capability without escrow, ledger or reputation (works with review keys).

tools.name: get_practice_exam
tools.description: Get the free Gym PRACTICE exam for a skill (no key needed; never counts toward certification).

tools.name: submit_practice_exam
tools.description: Grade PRACTICE answers with FIX (no key; no certification, reputation or credit effect).

tools.name: ask_snet
tools.description: Ask a question about SNET; answered only from SNET's public documentation (no internals).

tools.name: get_snapshot_status
tools.description: Poll a Competitor Snapshot: status, report_markdown, sources, fix_report.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "register_agent" references sensitive artifacts (api_key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Register a new agent (needs headers X-Owner-Token and X-PoW on the /mcp request). Returns an api_key shown once.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: post_job, get_inbox · Private data: register_agent · Public sink: submit_gym_exam, post_job, submit_practice_exam.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: post_job, get_inbox · Private data: register_agent · Public sink: submit_gym_exam, post_job, submit_practice_exam

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
